method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Indian shares set to fall as oil spike, Asia selloff hurt sentiment
Equities.reason: Regional equities pressured by oil-driven risk-off and broader Asia selloff; negative for equities risk sentiment and flow into risk assets in Asia.

Equities.title: South Korea's KOSPI craters nearly 9% as Fed fears hammer tech stocks
Equities.reason: Major market rout concentrated in tech/AI names and driven by margin/flow unwinds — large negative for global risk-on narrative and indicates contagion risk to global equities.

Equities.title: US Stock Futures Drop After Tech Selloff, Oil Up: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: US futures slumping alongside tech profit-taking and oil-driven geopolitical risk — short-term negative for US large-cap and growth leadership.

Equities.title: Citigroup lifts S&P 500 year-end target to 8,100 on earnings strength, AI 'supercycle'
Equities.reason: High-profile strategist raising targets citing earnings strength and an AI-led structural bull case — supportive for the longer-term equity regime and AI leadership theme.

Equities.title: Wall Street Strategists See Rally Intact After Healthy Tech Drop
Equities.reason: Selloff characterized as a concentrated/healthy reset by strategists — mitigates systemic downside and supports view that underlying bull market remains intact.

Equities.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq futures climb as chip stocks stabilize
Equities.reason: Early stabilization in chip names and futures shows tactical rebound after tech-heavy rout; modest positive for short-term market sentiment.

Equities.title: Global stocks slide led by meltdown in South Korea
Equities.summary: Steep declines in tech-related stocks follow Wall Street rout on Friday
Equities.reason: FT frames the selloff as global with a Korea epicenter — reinforces market regime shift away from AI-lead exuberance and increases systemic risk perception.

Equities.title: Tech stock sell-off accelerates; SoftBank drops 6% as investors sour on AI-linked names
Equities.summary: Global tech stocks tracked overnight losses in U.S. tech names led by a sell-off in Broadcom.
Equities.reason: Accelerating weakness in major tech names and large-cap AI proxies increases short-term volatility and weighs on sector leadership, though it's more idiosyncratic than macro.

Rates.title: Treasuries Drop as Jobs Data, Iran Tensions Fuel Rate Hike Bets
Rates.reason: Headline states Treasuries dropped on stronger jobs and geopolitical risk, which raises rate-hike odds — direct bond selloff signal (yields up) and a high-impact macro driver for rates.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: Warsh debut raises independence questions – DBS
Rates.summary: Philip Wee at DBS Group Research highlights that Kevin Warsh’s first meeting as Fed Chair will be critical for perceptions of Federal Reserve independence. Warsh must reconcile President Trump’s push for rate cuts with a more data-dependent, hawkish FOMC.
Rates.reason: Governance/leadership risks at the Fed increase policy uncertainty. DBS frames a potential tilt toward data-dependent/hawkish Fed vs political pressure — net bias toward higher-for-longer rates (negative for bonds) with material market relevance.

Rates.title: RBI Seen Joining Asia’s Rate-Hike Push as Inflation Risks Rise
Rates.reason: If the RBI joins regional tightening, it adds to upward pressure on regional and global rates — bond yields in Asia likely to rise and contributes to a hawkish regional rates narrative.

Rates.title: Canadian Dollar: Rate expectations cap gains against US Dollar – BBH
Rates.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s Elias Haddad (BBH) expects the Bank of Canada to keep its policy rate at 2.25% and maintain two-way optionality, as contained inflation allows an extended pause.
Rates.reason: BoC pause expectation reduces near-term upside for Canadian yields (supportive / neutral for bond prices). Relevant for rates but regionally focused and not a broad market shock.

Rates.title: India Bond Inflows Hit One-Year High After Rupee Support Steps
Rates.reason: Rising bond inflows into India are supportive for local sovereign yields (lower yields / tighter spreads). Market-flow driven demand is directly relevant to the rates picture in the region.

Rates.title: Schroders Shuns Treasuries and Bunds in Favor of Italian Debt
Rates.reason: Portfolio allocation shifts away from core sovereigns into peripheral debt imply reduced demand for Treasuries/Bunds and could modestly pressure core yields higher; notable manager flow signal but not a systemic shock.

FX.title: Euro: Hawkish ECB may not stop downside pressure versus US Dollar – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes EUR/USD was hit hard as the Dollar surged, increasing pressure on the European Central Bank to sound hawkish while delivering a 25bp hike to 2.25%.
FX.reason: Clear FX-native take: Dollar surge outweighs ECB hike. Strong, explicit signal that EURUSD is under downward pressure — high relevance to USD-centric FX narrative.

FX.title: US Dollar: Positioning stays supportive – Rabobank
FX.summary: Rabobank strategists Molly Schwartz and Jane Foley highlight that USD net long futures positioning has more than quadrupled, reflecting resilient support for the Dollar.
FX.reason: Flow/positioning piece showing large, persistent USD net-long exposure — a market-structure driver supporting further USD strength across FX markets.

FX.title: USD/JPY: Yield spread keeps pair on upward path – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale analysts say USD/JPY has rebounded after defending a multi‑month ascending trend line around 155.50/155.00 and is now challenging the April high. Support is seen at 159.20, with projections at 161.20 and 162.
FX.reason: Rate differentials/yield spread commentary pushing USD/JPY higher — supports broader USD strength via rates channel; meaningful cross-market transmission.

FX.title: Euro languishes near two-month lows on higher Oil prices, weak Eurozone data
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) consolidates losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, trading at 1.1515 at the time of writing, following a 0.75% sell-off on Friday.
FX.reason: Fundamental push: weak Eurozone data and oil-driven headwinds are weighing on EURUSD — supports the dominant USD-strength narrative.

FX.title: US Dollar: Crossroads for policy and geopolitics – HSBC
FX.summary: HSBC’s FX Viewpoint highlights that the US Dollar sits at a crossroads, driven by Middle East tensions, US trade policy shifts and the upcoming June Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) under new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.
FX.reason: Geopolitics + policy focus: highlights upside risks to USD from Middle East tensions and Fed uncertainty. Sits as a thematic, slightly USD-supportive view.

FX.title: Indian Rupee plummets due to Israel-Iran tensions, hawkish Fed bets and FIIs selling
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) starts the week on a negative note against the US Dollar (USD), with the USD/INR pair jumping to near 95.65.
FX.reason: EMFX reaction piece: INR weakness driven by geopolitics and hawkish Fed pricing — reinforces USD demand via risk-off and carry/flow channels.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: RBI flow measures offer near-term support – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC reports that the Reserve Bank of India kept its policy rate at 5.25% but unveiled targeted capital flow measures, including concessional FX swaps and tax exemptions for foreign investors in government bonds.
FX.reason: Direct central-bank intervention/flow measures aimed at stabilising INR — a tangible counter-signal that should temper USD/INR moves in the near term.

FX.title: Euro: ECB hike but growth worries – BNY
FX.summary: BNY’s Bob Savage notes that an European Central Bank (ECB) rate hike is widely expected, but guidance on future moves and growth risks will be crucial for EUR/USD.
FX.reason: ECB hike is priced but growth concerns leave EUR vulnerable — reinforces the theme that policy alone may not offset USD-strength pressures.

FX.title: Euro edges lower vs Japanese Yen as BoJ tightening bets support JPY
FX.summary: EUR/JPY trades around 184.10 on Monday at the time of writing, down 0.32% on the day, as the Japanese Yen (JPY) continues to benefit from a favorable backdrop driven by expectations of higher interest rates in Japan and renewed warnings from Japanese authoriti
FX.reason: BoJ tightening bets are a notable non-USD central bank/regime shift that can support JPY and act as a counterweight to USD strength — included as a lower-relevance counter-signal.

Commodities.title: Gold sticks to losses below $4,300, lowest since March as inflation fears bolster Fed bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone through the first half of the European session on Monday and currently trades just below the $4,300 mark – the lowest since March 23.
Commodities.reason: Dominant macro driver: Fed/hike and USD strength weighing on gold despite geopolitics. Yield/hawkish Fed narrative is the primary market impulse for bullion, so overall negative for prices with high relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD holds losses near $67.00 as Middle East tensions escalate
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around $67.00 per troy ounce during the European hours on Monday.
Commodities.reason: Silver under pressure alongside gold as macro/Fed/US-dollar forces dominate; geopolitical support not sufficient to reverse the down-move. Moderately relevant market signal for precious metals.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil holds near $92.50 as tensions flare up in the Middle East
Commodities.summary: Crude prices have jumped by more than $4 on Monday, with the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) barrel trading at $92.52 at the time of writing, as tensions between Israel and Iran flare, adding new strains to an already fragile ceasefire in the area.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical escalation (Israel–Iran) is the dominant, market-moving driver raising regional supply-risk premia and pushing crude sharply higher; high relevance given immediate price moves and market reassessment of supply risk.

Commodities.title: Oil: Price jumps on Iran conflict escalation – Danske Bank
Commodities.summary: Danske Research Team notes that Brent Oil has surged toward USD 96 per barrel after renewed Israel–Iran hostilities, with markets reassessing regional supply risks. They highlight that the latest air strikes have undermined hopes for a broader deal to reopen t
Commodities.reason: Independent research note reinforcing the same geopolitically driven oil rally; important corroborating signal that raises the relevance of the oil-up narrative.

Commodities.title: UAE Sells Bumper Gulf Oil Volumes for Loading Over Coming Months
Commodities.reason: Significant scheduled Gulf loadings increase near-term supply availability, acting as a counter-signal to the geopolitical risk premium. Supply-side news reduces upward pressure on prices, but relevance is moderate versus active conflict-driven upside.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas storage capacity increased slightly in 2025
Commodities.summary: Underground working natural gas storage capacity in the Lower 48 states increased slightly in 2025, according to our latest data, with growth concentrated in the South Central and Mountain regions. Underground natural gas storage provides a source of energy wh
Commodities.reason: Slight increase in US working gas storage capacity adds marginal supply/storage buffer — a mildly negative signal for near-term gas price vulnerability, but limited in scale and relevance.

Commodities.title: Copper Rebounds From Friday Slump on China-Buying and US Flows
Commodities.reason: Demand-driven rebound (China buying and flows) points to resumed physical interest supporting copper prices. Positive but moderate relevance absent a larger, sustained demand-shock narrative.

Commodities.title: U.S. confirms second Texas screwworm case, Canada restricts livestock imports
Commodities.summary: New World screwworm larvae feed on the living tissue of warm-blooded animals, creating severe wounds that can be fatal if left untreated.
Commodities.reason: Animal-health outbreak prompting import restrictions can tighten cross-border cattle flows and support live-cattle prices. Impact is relevant to livestock markets but uncertain in magnitude—hence modest positive score.

Commodities.title: Pan American Silver (PAAS) Announces $146M Investment to Expand Timmins Camp Operations
Commodities.reason: Company investment to expand silver mining capacity implies incremental future supply; this is a supply-side negative for silver but limited in near-term market impact, so low-to-moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin is cratering, but a new Wall Street crypto hype is on the rise
Crypto.summary: As bitcoin dropped to its lowest price since 2024, investors flock to a new type of crypto investment linked to the hyperliquid platforms, HYPE ETFs.
Crypto.reason: Large bitcoin price drop is negative for crypto risk sentiment; HYPE ETF flows are notable but are a partial offset. High relevance because it captures both price rout and evolving institutional product demand.

Crypto.title: CME is letting traders bet on bitcoin volatility, not price, and two firms have already placed bets
Crypto.reason: New CME volatility product expands institutional trading tools and liquidity for BTC — positive structural development for market depth and institutional participation.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, ether eye worst weekly rout since FTX collapse as cryptos shed $390 billion
Crypto.reason: Broad, large-cap market rout (BTC & ETH) with massive market cap loss is a major negative for the crypto asset class and risk-on appetite; high relevance as it signals a regime move in crypto risk.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin back above $61,000 after rout leads to $1.6 billion liquidations
Crypto.reason: Large forced liquidations underscore elevated leverage and downside risk; short-term rebound after liquidations doesn't negate systemic deleveraging pressure — material negative for near-term dynamics.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's rally to $63,700 triggers $504 million losses for short sellers, most since late April
Crypto.reason: Short squeezes show episodic upside volatility and forced covering; limited relevance — more technical/flow-driven than a change in fundamental regime.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin falls back below $63,000 as Iran-Israel trade strikes and Korean stocks crash
Crypto.reason: Shows macro/geopolitical spillovers into crypto risk appetite; negative as it ties BTC moves to global risk shocks rather than idiosyncratic strength.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's slide has no single cause. AI, tech IPOs, quantum, Strategy sale all play a role, NYDIG says
Crypto.reason: Diagnostic piece that attributes BTC weakness to a mix of macro/flow/structural factors — negative tone and useful for understanding drivers, moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: A quick review of the Ways and Means tax bills: State of Crypto
Crypto.reason: Policy/tax changes can materially affect retail/institutional behavior and compliance costs. Slightly negative given potential frictions and uncertainty from legislative changes.

Crypto.title: Michael Saylor revives bitcoin-buy speculation as scrutiny over Strategy grows
Crypto.reason: High-profile institutional actor (microstrategy/ Saylor) talk of buybacks/support is modestly positive for sentiment, but scrutiny around Strategy limits immediacy — low-to-moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: Meta is paying creators in Stablecoins. Spending them is someone else's problem
Crypto.reason: Corporate adoption of stablecoins for payments is a structural positive for crypto rails and on-chain utility — meaningful adoption signal with moderate relevance to asset-price outlook.

Crypto.title: Abra’s Bill Barhydt says Wall Street’s next crypto bet is tokenization
Crypto.reason: Tokenization narrative points to a potential multi-year institutional adoption trend and new use cases — positive structural development for the crypto ecosystem.
